caption: Two hands work a tuft of white fibrous material against a softly blurred tan backdrop. The left thumb and index finger pinch one edge while the right index and middle fingers grip the opposite side, drawing the loose, wispy strands inward. As the manipulation continues, the left hand shifts from a near-vertical pinch to a horizontal grip with its nails turned toward the camera, and the right hand turns so its fingernails face the camera where its knuckles had been. The fluffy mass gathers into a rounded white ball held between the fingertips of both hands, with stray fibers at its edges. The gathered mass shifts from the left side of the frame toward the center as the fingers adjust their hold. The hands keep pressing and shaping the fiber, the surface becoming more consolidated while a few loose wisps remain at the margins. The ball remains cradled between the pinched fingertips as the working motion continues.
relations: Pinching the loose white fibers between opposing fingertips draws wispy strands inward toward the center of the mass.
Rotating the hands so nails face the camera consolidates the fluffy material into a rounded ball held between fingertips.
Pressing and molding the gathered fibers shifts the ball toward the frame's center while leaving stray wisps at the margins.
